notes.subject: ngiri ikũmi na inyanya
notes.rationale: Perimeter of the city counted as eighteen thousand, closing the temple-measurement sequence of Ezekiel 40–48.

notes.subject: סביב
notes.rationale: Hebrew has only the adverb 'round about' with no unit word; versions add 'measures', 'reeds', or 'cubits'.

notes.subject: unit of the 18,000
notes.rationale: KJV 'measures', ASV/JPS 'reeds', BSB 'cubits' — the Hebrew names no unit, only the number and 'round about'.

notes.subject: יהוה שמה
notes.rationale: The city's closing name 'Yahwe Cama' — 'Yahwe nĩ arĩ kũu' — echoes the temple name; the Hebrew pun שם/שמה (name/there) is lost in Gĩkũyũ.

notes.subject: ⟨nĩ⟩
notes.rationale: Gĩkũyũ copula marker supplied; Hebrew juxtaposes יהוה שמה without a verb.

translation: Ĩgũyũrirĩte ngiri ikũmi na inyanya; na rĩĩtwa rĩa gĩtĩ kĩu kuuma mũthenya ũcio nĩrĩkĩ: Yahwe ⟨nĩ⟩ arĩ kũu.
